landing.welcome: Everything for your wedding, in one calm place.
space.title: Your preparations
space.intro: Choose an event to see what to prepare, plan its budget and find providers.
space.visitorHint: You can explore freely. Create an account to save checklists, budgets and providers.
events.title: Events
events.personaliseSignIn: Sign in to add, rename, reorder or hide events. Every family celebrates differently.
events.personaliseIntro: Add, rename, reorder or hide events. Not every family celebrates every event, or in the same order.
events.emptyText: Add the events your family celebrates.
events.name: Event name
events.renameHint: Leave the suggested name to keep it updated automatically.
events.removeSuggested: It will disappear from your space. You can restore it later.
events.removeCustom: This event and its budget, checklist and expenses will be deleted.
categories.title: What to prepare
categories.customiseIntro: Hide, rename or reorder categories, or add your own.
categories.emptyText: Add your own categories for this event.
checklist.title: Checklist
guide.title: Guidance
notes.title: Notes
budget.independentNote: Each event has its own independent budget. They are never added together.
budget.independentShort: This budget belongs to this event only.
budget.noneYet: No budget set for this event yet.
budget.totalHint: The total you plan for this event only.
budget.allocationNotSpending: Allocating is planning, not spending. Record payments as expenses.
budget.noEventBudget: You haven't set this event's budget yet.
budget.formula: Unallocated = event budget − sum of category allocations.
budget.warnOverAllocatedBy: Allocations exceed the event budget by {amount}.
budget.warnBelowAllocated: This is less than what is already allocated ({amount}).
budget.warnOverspent: Spending is above this category's allocation.
budget.warnEventOverspent: Spending is above this event's budget.
budget.signInText: Sign in to set a budget for each event and track what you spend.
expense.title: Expenses
expense.separateNote: Expenses are what you actually paid or committed. They never change your allocations.
expense.label: What for
estimate.title: Price estimate
estimate.intro: Estimate a cost from the price ranges providers have shared.
estimate.otherRegions: no data for this wilaya, other regions shown
estimate.noData: There isn't enough reliable price information yet. Ask providers for a quote.
estimate.noItems: No price data for this category
estimate.partial: Some lines have no price data and are not included.
estimate.setBudgetHint: Allocate a budget to this category to see the status.
estimate.disclaimer: Estimates are indicative, not guaranteed. The provider's final quote may differ (delivery, setup, travel…).
providers.title: Providers
providers.noneForCategory: No providers listed for this category yet.
providers.availabilityManual: Availability notes are entered manually and may not be current.
contact.title: Contact
saved.title: Saved providers
saved.intro: Providers you want to keep in mind.
saved.emptyText: Tap the bookmark on a provider to keep it here.
saved.signInText: Sign in to save providers and find them on any device.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageIntro: The whole app will use this language.
settings.dataDemo: Demo mode: everything is saved in this browser only. It won't appear on your other devices.
settings.dataCloud: Your plan is saved securely in your account and available on all your devices.
auth.why: An account keeps your checklists, budgets and saved providers.
auth.mode: Sign in or create an account
auth.resetSent: If an account exists, you'll receive an email to reset your password.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.errorExists: An account already exists with this email.
auth.needAccountText: Create a free account to tick tasks, set budgets and save providers. You can keep exploring without one.
demo.banner: Demo mode · data is saved on this device only
demo.prices: Fictional sample prices, for demonstration only.
demo.contactText: This provider and its contact details are invented for demonstration. The link will open, but nobody real will answer.
demo.adminText: In demo mode you can open the admin dashboard with a local demo account. It only exists in this browser.
demo.adminButton: Open admin with the demo account
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.loadText: Check your connection and try again.
admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.noAccessText: This account is not an editor or administrator. Ask an administrator to give you a role.
admin.firstAdminHint: The first administrator is set up once in the database — see docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md.
admin.overviewIntro: A summary of the platform's content and what needs attention.
admin.storageDemo: Demo mode: changes are saved in this browser only and are NOT visible on other devices. Connect the hosted database to share changes (see README).
admin.storageCloud: Hosted database: changes are visible to all users on all devices.
admin.eventsIntro: Events shown to users. Tap an event to manage its categories.
admin.structureIntro: Categories and subcategories of this event. Each can target El 3rossa, El 3ris or both.
admin.itemsIntro: Checklist items, suggestions, tips, traditions, notes and images.
admin.deleteEventWarn: Its categories and guidance will be deleted. Users' budgets and expenses are kept. Consider hiding it instead.
admin.deleteCategoryWarn: Its subcategories and guidance will be deleted. Users' allocations and expenses are kept. Consider hiding it instead.
admin.deleteProviderWarn: The provider, its portfolio and offers will be deleted. Its price records stay but lose the link.
admin.deleteServiceWarn: Links to categories and providers will be removed.
admin.deletePriceItemWarn: All price records of this item will be deleted.
admin.deleteRegionWarn: Providers and prices will lose this location. Communes of a deleted wilaya are deleted too.
admin.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.
admin.slugHint: Short technical identifier used in links. Leave empty to generate it.
admin.enabledHint: Hidden content is not shown to users but is kept.
admin.translationsHint: Each language is saved separately. A dot marks a missing required translation.
admin.f.name: Name
admin.f.title: Title
admin.f.caption: Caption
admin.serviceTypesHint: Users see these providers and price items from this category.
admin.providersIntro: Providers are managed here. Contact happens outside 3ARSSI (WhatsApp, phone, Instagram).
admin.providerContactRequired: Add at least one contact method.
admin.verifiedHint: Only mark as verified after you checked the provider yourself.
admin.saveFirst: Save the provider first to add photos, offers and prices.
admin.dateOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
admin.servicesIntro: Types of providers (halls, photographers…). Group, rename, reorder or hide them.
admin.groupHint: Optional: make this a sub-type of another service.
admin.pricesIntro: Each price item is ONE comparable product or service with ONE unit. Only records of the same item are combined into a range.
admin.priceItemHint: Create a separate item for different units or package contents.
admin.priceItemServiceHint: Links the item to categories through this service type.
admin.sourceHint: Where this price comes from (required without a provider).
admin.priceSourceRequired: Choose a provider or enter a source.
admin.priceBoth: Enter both the lowest and the highest price, or neither.
admin.priceOrder: The highest price must be at least the lowest price.
admin.priceEnabledHint: Hidden prices are not used in estimates.
admin.quoteUnit: Custom-quote items have no price range; users are asked to request a quote.
admin.unitHint: Estimates are only calculated in this unit.
admin.unitChangeWarn: Changing the unit affects every price record of this item.
admin.translationsIntro: Edit interface text and see content missing a translation. Each language is independent.
admin.uiOverrideHint: Leave empty to use the default text.
admin.regionsIntro: Wilayas and communes used by providers, prices and regional guidance.
admin.demoIntro: Fictional sample records used to explore the product. They are always labelled as samples.
admin.demoSafe: Only records flagged as demo are affected. Your real content is never touched.
admin.removeDemoWarn: Every fictional provider, price and offer will be deleted.
admin.restoreDemoCloud: To restore demo content in the hosted database, run supabase/seed/03_demo.sql (see docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md).
admin.resetDeviceWarn: All demo-mode data in this browser (accounts, plans, admin changes) will be erased and the starter content reloaded.
admin.usersIntro: Give people the editor role (content) or administrator role (content, users, demo data).
admin.rolesHelp: Editors manage content. Administrators also manage users and demo content. Roles are enforced by the database.
admin.errorPermission: You don't have permission for this action.
auth.errorBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in. Allow cookies for this site (on iPhone: Settings → Safari → turn off "Prevent Cross-Site Tracking"), then try again.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
auth.resetInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.
